description: The image presents a plan view titled "Diagram 2.22 Wall type 2 – external cavity wall with timber frame inner leaf". The label "PLAN" appears in the bottom right corner. The drawing depicts a section of an external wall on the left, represented by a vertical column of hatched blocks. Adjacent to this is a gap, known as the cavity. To the right of the cavity is a vertical inner leaf, containing insulation depicted as a continuous wavy line. Extending horizontally to the right from this inner leaf are the two leaves of the masonry separating wall, shown as cross-hatched blocks with a gap between them. In the cavity of the external wall, where the separating wall meets it, a cross-hatched block is shown. A leader line points to this block, labelled "Cavity stop".
